title: subagent: Find when Aquinas image added

content:
I need to find out when a picture of St. Thomas Aquinas was first added to the Wikipedia page on the "Principle of double effect". 

The URL is: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Principle_of_double_effect

Please:
1. Visit the page history at https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Principle_of_double_effect&action=history
2. Look through the edit history to find when an image of St. Thomas Aquinas was first added
3. Also check the current page to see what image exists and try to find when it was uploaded/added
4. Report the exact date (DD/MM/YYYY format) when the image was first added

Use webfetch and websearch tools to accomplish this.
I'll investigate this systematically. Let me start by fetching the page history and the current page simultaneously
